scenario.name: r-cd-model-default
scenario.description: Default provider/model inheritance for continue_delegate tool and bracket/token forms when no override is supplied.
scenario.registryNotes: Local scratch conversion: runnable k6 scenario covers typed continue_delegate no-model override default inheritance; bracket no-model remains review gap unless separately added.

invocation.promptTemplate: MDEF:{{nonceSuffix16}} Proof nonce {{nonce}}: reply exactly MODEL-DEFAULT-CHILD {{nonce}} MODEL <provider/model>, replacing <provider/model> with the current model identity from runtime context. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the parent request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate for this model row

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-correlated delegate child session/run is observed on the subscribed session stream or session history

expectedReceipts.name: child-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Child SERVED provider/model from the row-bound assistant message in the child's own chat.history inside the row run window (after the row anchor, first message carrying the row sentinel; stopReason recorded). sessions.describe model/modelProvider is recorded separately as the persisted SELECTION and alone yields PARTIAL (selection matched; served route unproven). Active fallback or a mixed served window is FAIL (#561/#562 review). The child self-report is auxiliary and never used for equality (#559).

expectedReceipts.name: return-payload
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return includes the row nonce and observed model/provider summary

expectedReceipts.name: trace-or-session-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id, span tree, or session-event correlation tying dispatch to child and return

expectedReceipts.name: parent-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Parent SERVED provider/model: the parent's own chat.history assistant message carrying MODEL-DEFAULT-PARENT-SCHEDULED <nonce> after the dispatch message is the inheritance baseline; the parent sessions.describe selection is recorded alongside. Optional OPENCLAW_EXPECTED_MODEL pins the served baseline; a wrong pin is the negative control (FAIL).

review.notes: PASS-candidate only when both tool and bracket/token no-override forms produce child sessions whose model/provider matches the parent baseline. This is the contrast row for explicit override rows.

liveRunSafety.notes: Default model inheritance row. This scratch scenario covers typed-tool no-model path; manifest review originally asks both typed and bracket forms, so fold should decide whether this is full row or typed-subcase only.
